# Pump curve notes

These notes use **bold**, _italic_ and *starred* text, a [link](https://example.org/a_(b) "title"), and an image ![diagram](fig.png).

## Inline code and code blocks

Call `pump.trim(diameter)` after reading `__init__.py`; the setting `sync.chunk_size_kb` stays as written.

```python
def trim(d):
    return d * 0.9  # keep my_var_name as is
```
